ITEM 1 | Yellow corn-like cylinder slice, bright yellow kernels with a pale cream center, round disc about 4.5 cm across and roughly 2.5 cm thick, sitting at the upper left of the plate, matte and moist-looking, holds its shape | 45
ITEM 2 | Flat square piece about 6 cm per side with golden-brown crust edges and a thin, slightly irregular top, covered in glossy red-orange tomato-like sauce with some darker spots, flat and dry-edged, sitting on the plate's left-center | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-cream strip about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide, smooth and slightly glossy, lying across the center of the square piece, soft-looking and firm enough to hold its shape | 8
ITEM 4 | Small scattered green sprig pieces, bright green, a few leaves about 0.5 cm each, resting on the square piece near the cream strip, dry and thin | 2
ITEM 5 | Thin pale wooden or stick-like sliver about 2 cm long, angled across the top of the square piece near the herbs, dry and light tan | 1
